events.factual_description: The Anthem presents Robyn's Sexistential Tour with Nourished by Time on September 8 and 9, 2026 in Washington, DC. Both nights list doors at 6:30 PM and showtime at 8:00 PM. The September 8 performance is sold out; The Anthem explicitly says the September 9 performance was added after the first night sold out. The venue identifies Sexistential as Robyn's ninth studio album and her follow-up to 2018's Honey; Apple Music lists Sexistential as released March 27, 2026 via Konichiwa / Young.

en.why_it_matters: The reason to flag this is the specific Sexistential chapter, not celebrity: The Anthem catches Robyn in the tour cycle for her first new studio album since Honey, with enough Washington demand to sell out the first night and add a second. Nourished by Time keeps the bill connected to a current, left-of-center pop/R&B voice, so this is a useful snapshot of where Robyn's dance-pop language sits now rather than a generic legacy booking.
en.trip_verdict: If you're in the DMV, target the added September 9 night: September 8 is sold out, and the second show makes this easy to prioritize without turning it into a travel project. Build the evening around The Anthem while primary tickets remain available through the official link.

es.why_it_matters: La razón para marcarla es el capítulo específico de Sexistential, no la fama: The Anthem recibe a Robyn en la gira de su primer álbum de estudio desde Honey, con suficiente demanda en Washington para agotar la primera noche y añadir una segunda. Nourished by Time mantiene el cartel conectado con una voz actual y lateral del pop/R&B, así que la fecha funciona como una foto de dónde está hoy el lenguaje dance-pop de Robyn y no como una contratación genérica de catálogo.
es.trip_verdict: Si estás en el DMV, apuntaría a la fecha añadida del 9 de septiembre: la del 8 está agotada y la segunda noche permite priorizarla sin convertirla en un viaje. Armaría la noche alrededor de The Anthem mientras siga disponible la venta primaria en el enlace oficial.
